items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: George Brock the trumpet player and I can’t remember that drummer but the drummer was phenomenal.

ctx.x: Those guys could play though, man.

Oh could they ever. I saw every Spike Jones — if there were two musicians I would be there at some point if they were within 200 miles of me, those two are Louis Armstrong and the other was Spike Jones. I went to — every year he would come and pack Symphony Hall which holds 4,500 people, two shows a day and it was the funniest stuff you ever heard. You know the things that I learned from Spike Jones is, as you said, those guys were some of the best musicians in the world. George Brock the trumpet player and I…

Yeah. It came off as spontaneous but was not. It was really arranged. What do you think, do you have an opinion if you observe what has happened to jazz education and its growth, I’m not sure I have a question here but I’m amazed at the level that jazz © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
